description: Latiffianti, Effi and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The source supplies online and offline code archives implementing cumulative-sum analysis of multivariate time series for turbine gearbox failure detection. The two variants belong to one source-defined algorithm family. Reproducibility reports accompany the code, but no code or report body was inspected. Coverage is gearbox condition estimation; exact channels, threshold settings and test-failure counts are not stated in the native description. Actual code availability is established by the explicit software descriptions. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
